name: project-operations
description: Poppy is a personal, skills-only Codex partner for project decisions, verified delivery, and evidence-aware communication.

interface.longDescription: Poppy preserves the user's outcome, selects only the project, delivery, research, context, assurance, or learning phase that can change the result, acts within explicit authority, verifies consequential claims, and communicates for the named reader.
defaultPrompt: Poppy, turn this rough idea into a recommendation, then implement the selected outcome.
Poppy, diagnose this defect and verify the fix.
Poppy, tell me what this project needs next and give me the decision-ready version.
